hooks.command: bash -c 'TOOL="$HOOK_TOOL_NAME"; ARGS="$HOOK_TOOL_INPUT"; if [ "$TOOL" = "write" ] || [ "$TOOL" = "create" ] || [ "$TOOL" = "edit" ]; then if echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE "iccDEV/" 2>/dev/null; then if ! echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE "cfl/iccDEV/" 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"permissionDecision\": \"deny\", \"reason\": \"iccDEV/ is upstream read-only. Use cfl/iccDEV/ for patched builds.\"}"; exit 0; fi; fi; fi; echo "{\"permissionDecision\": \"allow\"}"'
